title: I Took the Ferry-Transfer Receipt to the Inspector Who Punched It Used

parts.text: I handed the transfer at 6:41 a.m. and inspector Cole punched USED before I boarded. The back of the slip still said VALID FOR ONE CONNECTION. I was thirty-one, commuter, holding a receipt that listed the 6:38 boat. Cole shrugged. "Transfers look used." I photographed the punch, the valid line, and the boat still at the dock. Then I asked for the inspector log. At 6:48 the booth pinged why a live transfer was marked used. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Cole wrote a new punch: LIVE UNTIL THE GATE. I keep the receipt in a sleeve. The dock finally looks like a connection, not a shrug.

social.video_title: He punched my live ferry transfer used — Part 1/1
social.description: 6:38 boat, a USED punch, a valid-for-one-connection line. Would you have asked for the inspector log?
